title: 4.3 Where Things Are
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Understand and use in, on, under, and next to and answer Where is the object? with one clear location sentence.
grammar_function: Where is the singular object? The object is in/on/under/next to the known noun. Singular only.
prerequisite: 4.1 rooms, 4.2 home objects, Unit 2 object nouns, and singular is.
speaking_outcome: Repeat four location sentences and two complete Where question-answer exchanges.
